items.exampleEn: The dog walked around uneasily when it heard the thunder.
items.exampleZh: 狗聽到雷聲時不安地走來走去。

items.exampleEn: Our hosts in Japan were warm and hospitable.
items.exampleZh: 在日本接待我們的主人既熱情又好客。

items.exampleEn: To the chef's displeasure, the customer added salt to the soup.
items.exampleZh: 令主廚不悅的是，那位客人在湯裡加了鹽。

items.exampleEn: Workers who are mistreated by their boss often quit.
items.exampleZh: 被老闆不當對待的員工往往會辭職。

items.exampleEn: The team's fearsome defense has not let in a goal all season.
items.exampleZh: 那支球隊可怕的防守整季都沒有失分。

items.exampleEn: I'm petrified of snakes, even small ones.
items.exampleZh: 我非常怕蛇，就算是小蛇也一樣。

items.exampleEn: He tenderly wrapped his grandmother's old letters in soft paper.
items.exampleZh: 他溫柔地用軟紙把祖母的舊信包起來。

items.exampleEn: The poor quality of the new phone disillusioned many loyal customers.
items.exampleZh: 新手機的品質不佳，讓許多忠實顧客大失所望。

items.sentenceEn: The farmer tenderly lifted the newborn lamb.
items.sentenceZh: 農夫溫柔地抱起剛出生的小羊。

items.audioEn: I was petrified when the elevator stopped between floors, but it started again after a minute.
items.audioZh: 電梯停在兩層樓之間時我嚇壞了，不過一分鐘後它又動了。

items.sentenceEn: The players looked uneasily at the clock in the final minutes.
items.sentenceZh: 比賽最後幾分鐘，球員們不安地看著時鐘。

items.sentenceEn: The manager made his displeasure clear in the meeting.
items.sentenceZh: 經理在會議中明白表達了他的不滿。

items.stemEn: The people in the village were so ____ that they invited us to stay for dinner.
items.stemZh: 村民們非常好客，還邀我們留下來吃晚餐。

items.stemEn: It is wrong to ____ pets or other animals.
items.stemZh: 虐待寵物或其他動物是不對的。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, my little cousin visited the zoo for the first time. She was excited until she saw the tigers. They looked so fearsome that she was petrified and hid behind her father. Then a zoo worker spoke to one tiger tenderly, in an affectionate voice, and it rolled over like a pet cat. My cousin watched uneasily at first, but soon she was laughing. The worker told us that some zoos once mistreated their animals, but things have changed.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我的小表妹第一次去動物園。她原本很興奮，直到看見老虎。牠們看起來好可怕，她嚇呆了，躲到爸爸身後。接著一位動物園人員用充滿感情的語氣溫柔地對一隻老虎說話，牠竟然像一隻家貓一樣翻了個身。表妹一開始不安地看著，但很快就笑了。那位人員告訴我們，以前有些動物園會虐待動物，但現在情況已經改變了。

questions.questionZh: 表妹看到老虎時有什麼反應？
options: 開心地拿出手機拍了很多照片

questions.questionZh: 老虎聽到人員說話後做了什麼？

referenceEn: She shook her head to show her displeasure.
She showed her displeasure by shaking her head.
rubricZh: 要用 displeasure 當名詞（例如 show her displeasure）
「搖頭」可寫，例如 shook her head、shaking her head 等
時態合理即可（例如 shook、shakes、showed 等）

items.promptZh: 在城市工作一年後，他對都市生活的美好想像破滅了。
referenceEn: A year of working in the city disillusioned him about city life.
After a year of working in the city, he was disillusioned with city life.
rubricZh: disillusion 可用主動或被動（例如 disillusioned him、was disillusioned with 等）
「在城市工作一年後」可寫，例如 after a year of working in the city 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 became disillusioned、has become disillusioned 等）
